from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd()
prod=Path.home()/'prediction_research_prod'
def read(p):
    if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink():return None
    return json.loads(p.read_text())
result={}
v4=read(Path('/tmp/prediction-full-a2z-live-v4-state.json'))
result['qualification_state']=v4
state=read(prod/'knowledge/codex_runtime/STATE.json')
result['production_state']=state
config=read(prod/'knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json')
paths=['control/codex_supervisor/supervisor.py','control/codex_supervisor/candidate_dispatch.py','control/codex_supervisor/model_quality_gate.py','control/codex_supervisor/astra_autonomous_review.py','control/codex_supervisor/astra_review_wake.py','control/codex_supervisor/build_wake.py','control/codex_supervisor/measurement_wake.py','control/hourly/ai_response.py','control/hourly/candidate_reporting.py']
drift=[]
for rel in paths:
    p=prod/rel
    if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink() or hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest():drift.append(rel)
result['production_source_drift']=drift
result['pin_mismatches']=[]
if config:
    for rel in paths[:7]:
        name=Path(rel).name
        key='supervisor_sha256' if name=='supervisor.py' else name+'_sha256'
        p=prod/rel
        if p.is_file() and config.get(key)!=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest():result['pin_mismatches'].append(name)
for task in ['DEV-PRED-ASTRA-AUTONOMOUS-FIRSTFAIL-LOG-20261005','DEV-PRED-PROD-CANONICAL-CLEAN-20261005','DEV-PRED-PROD-STAGED-DIFF-INSPECT-20261005']:
    r=read(Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'/(task+'.json'))
    result[task]={'status':r.get('status'),'claimed_at_utc':r.get('claimed_at_utc'),'completed_at_utc':r.get('completed_at_utc')} if r else None
stages=(v4 or {}).get('stages',[])
done=any(x.get('stage')=='report' and x.get('status')=='PASS' for x in stages)
result['report_stage_pass']=done
out=root/'audit-output-e003'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out/'runtime.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print('AUDIT_RUNTIME '+json.dumps({'v4_stages':[(x.get('stage'),x.get('status')) for x in stages][-4:],'report_pass':done,'source_drift':len(drift),'pin_mismatch':len(result['pin_mismatches']),'supervisor':(state or {}).get('state'),'reason':str((state or {}).get('reason'))[:70]},separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(0 if done and not drift and not result['pin_mismatches'] else 1)
